sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The diverse malignant, stromal, and immune cells in tumors affect growth, metastasis, and response to therapy.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Single-Cell Transcriptomic Analysis of Primary and Metastatic Tumor Ecosystems in Head and Neck Cancer》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We profiled transcriptomes of ∼6,000 single cells from 18 head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) patients, including five matched pairs of primary tumors and lymph node metastases.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Stromal and immune cells had consistent expression programs across patients.

evidence.text: We profiled transcriptomes of ∼6,000 single cells from 18 head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) patients, including five matched pairs of primary tumors and lymph node metastases.
Stromal and immune cells had consistent expression programs across patients.
